accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3: total stopping schedule
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The schedule and its total formula-returning guarantee are conditional on Open-ended Question 3 proving a uniform cutoff B_2(n).
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Conditional totality and exact formula output under the proved sharp-frontier cutoff; no unconditional stopping theorem is claimed.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Definition 2.10, lines 174-176; Theorem 5.1, lines 301-305; Assumption 7.1 and Propositions 7.2-7.4, lines 393-413
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source defines ID_G as the minimum, over identifying orders and polynomial sets, of the maximum total degree; its algorithm succeeds when d>=ID_G, and its HTC, IC, and AC bounds are respectively 2s+1, 2s+1, and s^4+2s^3+s^2 under maximum indegree s.
